decision.reason: [ev-b335114fe89c] is one highlight line saying only that mTLS is now supported for the GitHub App transport of GitRepository, ImageUpdateAutomation and Provider. It does not name the field or setting that selects GitHub App authentication or sets up mTLS. It also gives no API versions or Provider group. The proposed exposure flags every environment that uses these kinds at any version. That is broader than the change: it would include all GitRepository users, not only those using GitHub App transport. The versions it lists are not in the evidence either. A correct condition needs the specific spec field (for example the provider/GitHub App auth and TLS secret reference) that release notes, the upgrade guide or a CRD diff would supply.
